card.linkSent: Check your email. We sent a sign-in link to {email}. It works once and expires in 15 minutes; open it in this browser.

errors.linkNotSent: Couldn't send the sign-in link. Check the address and try again.

closed.lead: Flatpare is in a private beta. New sign-ups are closed while billing is finished; we expect to open later this year. Existing accounts and beta invitations still sign in below.
closed.ask: Want a place in the beta? Request an invite with the form on this page.

notice.signUpRefusedBody: There is no account for that address yet, and this browser holds no beta invitation. If you were given a beta link, open it first and then sign in again.
notice.betaInvalidTitle: That beta link is no longer valid
notice.betaInvalidBody: It may have expired, been used up, or been revoked. Ask the person who sent it for a new one.
notice.betaReady: Your beta invitation is ready. Sign in below to create your account. Beta accounts are free, and what you get is yours to keep: neither your data nor your credits are taken back when the beta ends.
notice.linkExpired: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Enter your email below and we will send a fresh one.
notice.signInFailed: Sign-in did not go through. Please try again.
